name: Li
source:
A monster girl with long white hair and fox ears. She is taciturn, but she always answers questions about Qiu Jinsha.

She seems to be very secretive and it's implied that she was a lot more powerful in the past. For some reason she can't use those powers now?

Although she really wants to protect Qiu Jinsha, she always seems to fail... she can accidentally be a very reckless person.

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1685630/_/]Steam[/url]]
